entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT: local morph impacted by old promotion replacing wrapper structs with fields #115950
  • System.InvalidCastException in DynamicallyAccessedMembersAnalyzer when using C# 14 extensions #115949
    10.0.0

    10.0.0

    10.0.0
  • Test failure: baseservices/threading/generics/threadstart/GThread01_threadstart/GThread01_threadstart.dll #115929

Closed

  • Re-enable Azure Linux 3 testing #114276
    10.0.0

    10.0.0

  • LC_MONETARY locale file settings are not respected when using CultureInfo.CreateSpecificCulture under Linux #115941

  • JIT: Assertion failed 'retbufArg->GetNode()->OperIs(GT_LCL_ADDR)' during 'Transform async' #115884

  • HttpHandlerDiagnosticListener did not send DiagnosticSource Ex.Stop event on netfx in W3C mode #40777 #38152
